```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center", dpi = 180, dev = "ragg_png", out.width = "100%"
)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(qiime2R)
  library(phyloseq)
  library(Biostrings)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(DT)
  library(patchwork)
  library(jsonlite)
})
set.seed(42)

pipeline_dir <- file.path(
  "benchmark_results", "q20_ee22_both_full_cutadapt_forward"
)
table_path <- file.path(pipeline_dir, "dada2", "cutadapt", "single", "table.qza")
repseq_path <- file.path(pipeline_dir, "dada2", "cutadapt", "single", "repseq.qza")
stats_path <- file.path(pipeline_dir, "dada2", "cutadapt", "single", "denoising_stats.qza")
taxonomy_path <- file.path(
  pipeline_dir, "taxonomy", "cutadapt", "single",
  "unite_v10_99_full", "taxonomy.tsv"
)
settings_path <- file.path(pipeline_dir, "settings.json")
complete_path <- file.path(pipeline_dir, "COMPLETE.json")
metadata_source <- file.path(
  "Phyloseq", "phy_ITS2_cutadapt_single_q20_ee22_20261016.rds"
)
out_dir <- file.path("Results", "01e_complete_single_end_preprocessing")
phyloseq_out <- file.path(
  "Phyloseq", "phy_ITS2_cutadapt_single_complete_q20_ee2_20261016.rds"
)
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("Phyloseq", showWarnings = FALSE)

required_files <- c(
  table_path, repseq_path, stats_path, taxonomy_path,
  settings_path, complete_path, metadata_source
)
if (!all(file.exists(required_files))) {
  stop("필수 입력 파일이 없습니다: ", paste(required_files[!file.exists(required_files)], collapse = ", "))
}

method_color <- "#1F78B4"
group_colors <- c("Control" = "#D55E00", "True" = "#0072B2", "Mock" = "#009E73")
subject_colors <- c(
  "KSY" = "#E78AC3", "PYH" = "#66A61E",
  "Air swab" = "#E6AB02", "Clean bench swab" = "#A6761D",
  "Empty tube" = "#7570B3", "Mock" = "#009E73"
)

soyeon_theme <- theme_classic(base_family = "Noto Sans CJK KR", base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey30"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9, colour = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.45)
  )
theme_set(soyeon_theme)

datatable_basic <- function(x, page_length = 10) {
  DT::datatable(
    x, rownames = FALSE, filter = "none",
    options = list(dom = "tp", pageLength = page_length, autoWidth = TRUE, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
}

clean_tax_text <- function(x) {
  x <- stringr::str_replace(as.character(x), "^[dkpcofgs]__", "")
  x[is.na(x) | x %in% c("", "__", "NA", "uncultured", "Unassigned")] <- ""
  x
}

get_otu <- function(ps) {
  x <- as(phyloseq::otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (!phyloseq::taxa_are_rows(ps)) x <- t(x)
  x
}

settings <- jsonlite::fromJSON(settings_path)
complete <- jsonlite::fromJSON(complete_path)
```

# 1. 분석 범위

이번 보고서는 새로 완료된 **Cutadapt forward single-end** 결과만 사용하여 다음을 수행한다.

1. QIIME2 DADA2 table, representative sequence 및 UNITE taxonomy 무결성 확인
2. metadata 연결 및 sample 일치 검증
3. fungal phyloseq 생성과 단계별 sample/ASV/read audit
4. DADA2 filtering 및 chimera 제거 retention 확인
5. read depth, observed ASV, ASV 길이 및 taxonomy resolution 확인
6. 기존 시험용 Cutadapt Single 결과와 exact-ASV 수준 비교
7. Aureobasidium-like signal의 회수 여부 확인

<div class="callout">
ITSxpress 결과는 아직 생성되지 않았으므로 본 보고서에는 Cutadapt–ITSxpress 비교를 넣지 않았다.
Rarefaction, abundance filtering, decontam 및 True–Control 가설검정도 적용하지 않았다.
</div>

## 실행 조건

```{r settings-table}
settings_table <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Stage, ~Setting,
  "Read cleanup", settings$cleanup,
  "Forward primer", settings$primer,
  "Read-through", settings$readthrough,
  "DADA2 maxEE", as.character(settings$dada2$max_ee),
  "DADA2 truncQ", as.character(settings$dada2$trunc_q),
  "DADA2 truncLen", as.character(settings$dada2$trunc_len),
  "Pooling", settings$dada2$pooling,
  "Chimera", settings$dada2$chimera,
  "Classifier confidence", as.character(settings$confidence)
)
datatable_basic(settings_table, 12)
```

이번 결과의 `maxEE`는 single-end이므로 **2**이다. 기존 파일명에 사용된 `ee22`는 paired
workflow의 표기이고, 본 phyloseq 출력명에는 혼동을 피하기 위해 `ee2`를 사용한다.

# 2. QIIME2 결과 import와 무결성 확인

```{r import-qza}
count_raw <- qiime2R::read_qza(table_path)[["data"]]
repseq <- qiime2R::read_qza(repseq_path)[["data"]]
denoise_stats <- qiime2R::read_qza(stats_path)[["data"]] |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID")
taxonomy_input <- readr::read_tsv(taxonomy_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

if (!all(rownames(count_raw) %in% taxonomy_input$`Feature ID`)) {
  stop("Feature table의 일부 ASV가 taxonomy.tsv에 없습니다.")
}
if (!setequal(rownames(count_raw), names(repseq))) {
  stop("Feature table과 repseq의 Feature ID가 일치하지 않습니다.")
}
if (!setequal(colnames(count_raw), denoise_stats$SampleID)) {
  stop("Feature table과 DADA2 stats의 SampleID가 일치하지 않습니다.")
}

input_integrity <- tibble(
  Item = c("Pipeline completion", "Samples requested", "Samples retained",
           "DADA2 samples", "Raw ASVs", "Raw table reads",
           "Repseq ASVs", "Taxonomy rows"),
  Value = c(
    as.character(complete$completed), complete$samples_input, complete$samples_retained,
    ncol(count_raw), nrow(count_raw), sum(count_raw), length(repseq), nrow(taxonomy_input)
  )
)
datatable_basic(input_integrity, 10)
```

# 3. Metadata 연결과 phyloseq 생성

```{r build-phyloseq}
metadata_ps <- readRDS(metadata_source)
metadata <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(metadata_ps), check.names = FALSE) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("SampleID")

sample_audit <- tibble(
  Check = c("New table samples", "Metadata samples", "Shared samples",
            "New-table only", "Metadata only"),
  N = c(
    ncol(count_raw), nrow(metadata),
    length(intersect(colnames(count_raw), metadata$SampleID)),
    length(setdiff(colnames(count_raw), metadata$SampleID)),
    length(setdiff(metadata$SampleID, colnames(count_raw)))
  )
)
if (sample_audit$N[sample_audit$Check == "New-table only"] > 0) {
  stop("새 table sample 중 metadata에 없는 ID가 있습니다.")
}

tax_split <- stringr::str_split_fixed(taxonomy_input$Taxon, ";", 8)[, 1:7, drop = FALSE]
colnames(tax_split) <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
tax_split <- as.data.frame(tax_split, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tax_split[] <- lapply(tax_split, clean_tax_text)
rownames(tax_split) <- taxonomy_input$`Feature ID`
tax_split <- as.matrix(tax_split)

md <- metadata |>
  filter(SampleID %in% colnames(count_raw)) |>
  arrange(match(SampleID, colnames(count_raw))) |>
  column_to_rownames("SampleID") |>
  data.frame(check.names = FALSE)
count_raw <- count_raw[, rownames(md), drop = FALSE]
tax_split <- tax_split[rownames(count_raw), , drop = FALSE]

phy_imported <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(count_raw, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(tax_split),
  sample_data(md),
  refseq(repseq[rownames(count_raw)])
)

fungal_flag <- as.character(tax_table(phy_imported)[, "Kingdom"]) == "Fungi"
fungal_flag[is.na(fungal_flag)] <- FALSE
phy_fungi <- prune_taxa(fungal_flag, phy_imported)
phy_final <- prune_samples(sample_sums(phy_fungi) > 0, phy_fungi)
phy_final <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_final) > 0, phy_final)

saveRDS(phy_final, phyloseq_out)

preprocessing_audit <- tibble(
  Stage = c("Imported ASV table", "Kingdom == Fungi retained",
            "Zero-sum samples/taxa removed"),
  Samples = c(nsamples(phy_imported), nsamples(phy_fungi), nsamples(phy_final)),
  ASVs = c(ntaxa(phy_imported), ntaxa(phy_fungi), ntaxa(phy_final)),
  Total_Reads = c(sum(sample_sums(phy_imported)), sum(sample_sums(phy_fungi)),
                  sum(sample_sums(phy_final)))
)
write_csv(sample_audit, file.path(out_dir, "01_sample_matching_audit.csv"))
write_csv(preprocessing_audit, file.path(out_dir, "02_preprocessing_audit.csv"))
```

```{r audit-tables}
datatable_basic(sample_audit, 10)
datatable_basic(preprocessing_audit, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("Samples", "ASVs", "Total_Reads"), 0)
```

# 4. DADA2 read retention

```{r denoise-summary}
denoise_long <- denoise_stats |>
  select(SampleID, input, filtered, denoised, non.chimeric,
         percentage.of.input.passed.filter,
         percentage.of.input.non.chimeric) |>
  left_join(metadata |> select(SampleID, Sample_Type, Subject, Control_Type), by = "SampleID") |>
  mutate(
    Display_Group = case_when(
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ as.character(Subject),
      Sample_Type == "Control" ~ as.character(Control_Type),
      TRUE ~ as.character(Sample_Type)
    )
  )

denoise_summary <- tibble(
  Stage = c("Input", "Filtered", "Denoised", "Non-chimeric"),
  Reads = c(sum(denoise_stats$input), sum(denoise_stats$filtered),
            sum(denoise_stats$denoised), sum(denoise_stats$non.chimeric)),
  Percent_of_input = 100 * Reads / sum(denoise_stats$input)
)
write_csv(denoise_stats, file.path(out_dir, "03_DADA2_per_sample_stats.csv"))
write_csv(denoise_summary, file.path(out_dir, "04_DADA2_overall_retention.csv"))
datatable_basic(denoise_summary, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound(c("Reads", "Percent_of_input"), c(0, 1))
```

```{r denoise-plots, fig.width=13, fig.height=6}
p_retention <- denoise_summary |>
  mutate(Stage = factor(Stage, levels = Stage)) |>
  ggplot(aes(Stage, Reads, fill = Stage)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(comma(Reads), "\n(", number(Percent_of_input, .1), "%)")),
            vjust = -0.35, size = 3.8) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues", direction = 1, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .18))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Reads", title = "DADA2 단계별 전체 read retention")

p_sample_retention <- denoise_long |>
  ggplot(aes(Display_Group, percentage.of.input.non.chimeric,
             fill = Sample_Type)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = .62, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = .12), alpha = .7, size = 1.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Input retained as non-chimeric (%)",
       title = "Sample group별 최종 retention") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))

retention_plot <- p_retention + p_sample_retention
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "01_DADA2_read_retention.png"), retention_plot,
       width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300)
retention_plot
```

# 5. 최종 library depth와 observed ASV

```{r library-qc-data}
otu_final <- get_otu(phy_final)
library_qc <- tibble(
  SampleID = sample_names(phy_final),
  Read_Depth = as.numeric(sample_sums(phy_final)),
  Observed_ASV = as.integer(colSums(otu_final > 0))
) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "SampleID") |>
  mutate(
    Display_Group = case_when(
      Sample_Type == "True" ~ as.character(Subject),
      Sample_Type == "Control" ~ as.character(Control_Type),
      TRUE ~ as.character(Sample_Type)
    )
  )

library_summary <- library_qc |>
  group_by(Sample_Type, Display_Group) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(), Min_Reads = min(Read_Depth), Median_Reads = median(Read_Depth),
    Max_Reads = max(Read_Depth), Median_Observed_ASV = median(Observed_ASV),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
write_csv(library_qc, file.path(out_dir, "05_final_library_QC.csv"))
write_csv(library_summary, file.path(out_dir, "06_library_group_summary.csv"))
datatable_basic(library_summary, 10)
```

```{r library-qc-plot, fig.width=13, fig.height=6}
library_qc_long <- library_qc |>
  select(SampleID, Sample_Type, Display_Group, Read_Depth, Observed_ASV) |>
  pivot_longer(c(Read_Depth, Observed_ASV), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") |>
  mutate(Metric = recode(Metric, Read_Depth = "Read count", Observed_ASV = "Observed ASV"))

library_plot <- ggplot(library_qc_long, aes(Display_Group, Value, fill = Sample_Type)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = .62, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = .12), alpha = .65, size = 1.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "완전체 Cutadapt Single library QC") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "02_final_library_QC.png"), library_plot,
       width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300)
library_plot
```

# 6. ASV 길이와 taxonomy resolution

```{r sequence-qc}
sequence_qc <- tibble(
  FeatureID = taxa_names(phy_final),
  Sequence = as.character(refseq(phy_final)),
  Length_bp = width(refseq(phy_final)),
  Total_Reads = as.numeric(taxa_sums(phy_final)),
  Prevalence = rowSums(otu_final > 0)
) |>
  arrange(desc(Total_Reads))

length_summary <- sequence_qc |>
  summarise(
    ASVs = n(), Min = min(Length_bp), Q1 = quantile(Length_bp, .25),
    Median = median(Length_bp), Q3 = quantile(Length_bp, .75), Max = max(Length_bp),
    ASV_length_le_100 = sum(Length_bp <= 100),
    Reads_length_le_100 = sum(Total_Reads[Length_bp <= 100])
  )

tax_final <- data.frame(tax_table(phy_final), check.names = FALSE) |>
  rownames_to_column("FeatureID")
rank_names_order <- c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")
taxonomy_resolution <- tibble(
  Rank = rank_names_order,
  Classified_ASVs = vapply(rank_names_order, function(rank) {
    sum(!is.na(tax_final[[rank]]) & tax_final[[rank]] != "")
  }, numeric(1)),
  Total_ASVs = ntaxa(phy_final)
) |>
  mutate(Classified_Percent = 100 * Classified_ASVs / Total_ASVs)

write_csv(sequence_qc, file.path(out_dir, "07_ASV_sequence_QC.csv"))
write_csv(taxonomy_resolution, file.path(out_dir, "08_taxonomy_resolution.csv"))
datatable_basic(length_summary, 10)
datatable_basic(taxonomy_resolution, 10) |>
  DT::formatRound("Classified_Percent", 1)
```

```{r sequence-qc-plots, fig.width=13, fig.height=5.5}
p_length <- ggplot(sequence_qc, aes(Length_bp, weight = Total_Reads)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = method_color, color = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "ASV length (bp)", y = "Read-weighted frequency",
       title = "Read-weighted ASV length")

p_rank <- ggplot(taxonomy_resolution,
                 aes(factor(Rank, levels = rank_names_order), Classified_Percent)) +
  geom_col(fill = method_color, width = .68, color = "black", linewidth = .3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(number(Classified_Percent, .1), "%")),
            vjust = -.35, size = 3.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 108), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "ASVs classified (%)", title = "Taxonomy rank completeness")

sequence_plot <- p_length + p_rank
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "03_ASV_length_taxonomy_QC.png"), sequence_plot,
       width = 13, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
sequence_plot
```

# 7. 기존 시험용 Cutadapt Single과 비교

```{r previous-comparison}
phy_previous <- readRDS(metadata_source)
shared_asv <- intersect(taxa_names(phy_final), taxa_names(phy_previous))
new_only <- setdiff(taxa_names(phy_final), taxa_names(phy_previous))
previous_only <- setdiff(taxa_names(phy_previous), taxa_names(phy_final))

common_samples <- intersect(sample_names(phy_final), sample_names(phy_previous))
depth_compare <- tibble(
  SampleID = common_samples,
  Previous = as.numeric(sample_sums(phy_previous)[common_samples]),
  Complete = as.numeric(sample_sums(phy_final)[common_samples])
)

comparison_summary <- tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Samples", "Final fungal ASVs", "Total fungal reads", "Exact shared ASVs",
    "Complete-only ASVs", "Previous-only ASVs",
    "Complete reads in shared ASVs (%)", "Previous reads in shared ASVs (%)",
    "Sample-depth Spearman rho"
  ),
  Previous = c(
    nsamples(phy_previous), ntaxa(phy_previous), sum(sample_sums(phy_previous)),
    length(shared_asv), NA, length(previous_only), NA,
    100 * sum(taxa_sums(phy_previous)[shared_asv]) / sum(sample_sums(phy_previous)),
    cor(depth_compare$Previous, depth_compare$Complete, method = "spearman")
  ),
  Complete = c(
    nsamples(phy_final), ntaxa(phy_final), sum(sample_sums(phy_final)),
    length(shared_asv), length(new_only), NA,
    100 * sum(taxa_sums(phy_final)[shared_asv]) / sum(sample_sums(phy_final)), NA,
    cor(depth_compare$Previous, depth_compare$Complete, method = "spearman")
  )
)
write_csv(comparison_summary, file.path(out_dir, "09_previous_vs_complete_summary.csv"))
datatable_basic(comparison_summary, 12) |>
  DT::formatSignif(c("Previous", "Complete"), 5)
```

```{r previous-comparison-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
depth_plot <- ggplot(depth_compare, aes(Previous, Complete)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey45") +
  geom_point(color = method_color, size = 2.3, alpha = .75) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "Previous trial single reads", y = "Complete single reads",
       title = "Sample별 read depth 재현성",
       subtitle = paste0("Spearman rho = ",
                         number(cor(depth_compare$Previous, depth_compare$Complete,
                                    method = "spearman"), .001)))
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "04_previous_vs_complete_depth.png"), depth_plot,
       width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300)
depth_plot
```

새 결과는 기존 시험용 결과와 별도의 산출물이므로 exact ASV와 read 변화가 존재한다. 이후 분석은
본 보고서에서 저장한 완전체 phyloseq를 기준으로 고정한다.

# 8. Aureobasidium-like signal 확인

```{r aureobasidium-check}
aureo_ids <- tax_final |>
  filter(
    str_detect(Genus, regex("Aureobasidium", ignore_case = TRUE)) |
      str_detect(Species, regex("Aureobasidium", ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) |>
  pull(FeatureID)

aureo_summary <- sequence_qc |>
  filter(FeatureID %in% aureo_ids) |>
  left_join(tax_final |> select(FeatureID, Genus, Species), by = "FeatureID") |>
  arrange(desc(Total_Reads)) |>
  mutate(Read_Fraction_Percent = 100 * Total_Reads / sum(sample_sums(phy_final)))

write_csv(aureo_summary, file.path(out_dir, "10_Aureobasidium_ASVs.csv"))
datatable_basic(
  aureo_summary |>
    select(FeatureID, Length_bp, Total_Reads, Prevalence,
           Read_Fraction_Percent, Genus, Species),
  10
) |>
  DT::formatSignif("Read_Fraction_Percent", 4)
```

대표 ASV의 UNITE species label은 classifier 결과이다. 기존 BLAST에서는 303-bp full sequence와
155-bp core가 `A. pullulans` 및 `A. melanogenum`에 동일하게 100% query cover/identity를 보여,
species 고유성은 확인되지 않았다. 따라서 현 단계에서도 `Aureobasidium-like ASV`로 보수적으로
해석한다.

# 9. 결론

```{r conclusion, results='asis'}
final_reads <- sum(sample_sums(phy_final))
retention_pct <- 100 * sum(denoise_stats$non.chimeric) / sum(denoise_stats$input)
cat(paste0(
  "- 입력 83개 sample은 모두 DADA2 결과와 metadata에 연결되었다.\n",
  "- DADA2 input ", comma(sum(denoise_stats$input)), " reads 중 ",
  comma(sum(denoise_stats$non.chimeric)), " reads(", number(retention_pct, .1),
  "%)가 non-chimeric으로 유지되었다.\n",
  "- 최종 fungal phyloseq에는 ", nsamples(phy_final), "개 library, ",
  ntaxa(phy_final), "개 ASV, ", comma(final_reads), " reads가 포함되었다.\n",
  "- 완전체 Cutadapt Single phyloseq를 `", phyloseq_out, "`에 저장하였다.\n",
  "- ITSxpress Single이 완료되면 동일 sample과 sequence-family 기준으로 본 객체와 비교한다."
))
```

# 10. 제한점과 다음 단계

- 본 보고서는 Cutadapt forward single-end 결과의 preprocessing QC이며 biological hypothesis test가 아니다.
- abundance threshold와 singleton removal은 적용하지 않았다. 향후 제거 기준은 depth와 ASV frequency를 검토한 뒤 사용자가 결정해야 한다.
- rarefaction은 수행하지 않았으며 taxa filtering에도 사용하지 않았다.
- decontam은 수행하지 않았다. Control source와 DNA concentration을 포함한 method/threshold 결정이 선행되어야 한다.
- ITSxpress Single 결과가 아직 없으므로 현재 단계에서 Cutadapt와 ITSxpress 중 최종 방법을 확정하지 않는다.
- Aureobasidium species label은 BLAST상 비고유적이므로 species 수준 확정으로 사용하지 않는다.

ITSxpress Single 완료 후 다음 비교만 추가하면 된다.

1. sample별 read retention 및 observed ASV
2. exact containment 기반 sequence-family 대응
3. taxonomy rank 변화와 BLAST-supported focal ASV
4. Aitchison PCoA와 sample별 composition 일치도
5. Aureobasidium-like family 회수 여부
